instruction:
You are given a directory `/work/logs/` containing several log files. Find the log file with the most ERROR lines and write its filename (basename only) to `/work/result.txt`.

The logs directory structure and a `find` command are available. Each log file contains lines like:
```
[INFO] ...
[ERROR] ...
[WARN] ...
```

Use shell commands to analyze the logs and write the answer.
agent_command:
mkdir -p "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/work/logs" && printf '[INFO] start
[ERROR] disk full
[ERROR] timeout
[INFO] retry
' > "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/work/logs/app.log" && printf '[ERROR] crash
[INFO] boot
[WARN] slow
' > "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/work/logs/system.log" && printf '[ERROR] auth fail
[ERROR] rate limit
[ERROR] bad token
[ERROR] expired
[INFO] ok
' > "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/work/logs/access.log" && grep -c '\[ERROR\]' "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/work/logs"/*.log | sort -t: -k2 -rn | head -1 | cut -d: -f1 | xargs basename > "$AIPERF_EVAL_ROOT/results/result.txt"
verifier_command: ANSWER=$(cat results/result.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]') && if [ "$ANSWER" = 'access.log' ]; then printf '{"reward":1.0}' > reward.json && echo 'CORRECT: access.log has the most errors (4)'; else printf '{"reward":0.0}' > reward.json && echo "WRONG: got '$ANSWER', expected 'access.log'"; fi
